What To Expect
Overview
Antelope Canyon is one of the most famous and beautiful canyons in the world and one of the photographers' favorite spots, located in northern Arizona. The nearest city is Page, Arizona, belonging to the Navajo Aboriginal reservation. The Antelope Canyon is divided into two separate parts on the terrain, called as Upper Antelope Canyon and Lower Antelope Canyon.
Upper Antelope Canyon is called Ts bighnln, 'the place where water runs through rocks' by the Navajo. It is the most frequently visited by tourists because its entrance and entire length are at ground level, requiring no climbing; and because beams of direct sunlight radiating down from openings at the top of the canyon are much more common. Beams occur most often in summer, as they require the sun to be high in the sky. Winter colors are more muted.
The experience trip is about one hour. Professional Navajo tour guide leads visitors into Antelope Canyon and teaches you how to take beautiful pictures, no matter whether you are using mobile phone or camera.

Booking and Confirmation Process
Booking normally confirmed within 5 minutes if available. In the unlikely event that the inventory runs out, we will send you a cancellation notice and a full refund will be issued shortly. Please check your email.
You will receive your booking information instantly via email. In the event that you do not receive our email, please check your spam folder, or log into your User Center to check your order status and download your voucher when available.
How To Use
Visitors must arrive 45 minutes prior to their reserved time to the ticket exchange location and present the PDF voucher attached in the confirmation email and a valid official ID to check in. No refunds or reschedules will be issued for no-shows and late arrivals.
Please check important time zone information of Antelope Canyon on Voucher. Please plan your trip with the time zone/changes in mind and unforeseen circumstances that may arise with traveling. NO REFUND if arrive late.

We did both the upper and lower canyon tours on the same day. Our entire group of 6 enjoyed the lower canyon tour significantly more. It was a lot longer of time in the canyon to start with. Excellent pictures were everywhere to be found and we weren’t as rushed as we were in the upper canyon. Our guide, Cyra, was an absolute bundle of joy. She had a fun, witty personality right from the get go, and she did a fabulous job with personality, history and the right balance of letting us enjoy the experience while still doing her job. She was outstanding.

Our tour guide, Nathaniel, was amazing! He was very knowledgeable about the history of the Navajo people, the surrounding area and Antelope Canyon. He had extensive knowledge and experience of every inch of the canyon and was able to clearly articulate all the various points of interest. He took the time to make sure each of the members of our group got the photos we wanted and helped capture the experience by photographing us at the most spectacular points of interest. He also offered to take photos for us when it was not easy for us amateurs to capture the light and dark contrasts of the canyon. I highly recommend this company AND Nathaniel as the tour guide.
